bio.text: Houston Brignano is the Republican candidate for California's 36th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to his campaign website, he is a South Bay native who joined the Marine Corps after high school and deployed to Iraq for two tours.
The site says he lives in the South Bay with his wife and three daughters and serves on the boards of a homeschool co-op in Redondo Beach and a church in Old Torrance.
